items.name: TESCO MEAL DEAL
items.reason: Making your own lunch using loaf bread and multipack items costs less than half the price of a daily meal deal.

items.name: COCA-COLA 500ML
items.swap: Tesco Classic Cola 2L or Multipack Cans
items.reason: Single 500ml chilled bottles have a huge markup; buy a 2L own-brand bottle or decant from a multipack.

items.name: WALKERS CRISPS MULTIPACK 6PK
items.reason: Supermarket own-brand multipack crisps are less than half the price of Walkers.

items.name: HEINZ BAKED BEANS 415G
items.swap: Tesco Baked Beans in Tomato Sauce 420g
items.reason: Own-brand baked beans cost around a third of the price of Heinz and taste very similar.

items.name: WARBURTONS MEDIUM WHITE
items.reason: Switching from Warburtons to standard supermarket own-brand bread saves nearly £1 per loaf.

items.name: KELLOGGS CORN FLAKES 500G
items.reason: Branded cereal is very expensive; Tesco's own-brand corn flakes save nearly £3 a box.

items.name: BEN & JERRYS COOKIE DOUGH
items.swap: Tesco Cookie Dough Ice Cream 480ml (or Aldi Gianni's)
items.reason: Never pay full price for Ben & Jerry's; either wait for a £3.50 Clubcard promo or buy own-brand cookie dough ice cream.

items.name: RED BULL 4PK
items.swap: Tesco Blue Spark 4x250ml (or Aldi Red Thunder)
items.reason: Own-brand energy drink 4-packs have the same caffeine content for nearly £5 less.

items.name: CHICKEN BREAST 650G
items.swap: Tesco Frozen Chicken Breast Fillets or Chicken Thighs
items.reason: Buying frozen chicken breasts or swapping to fresh chicken thighs offers a much lower price per kg.

items.name: TESCO PASTA 500G
items.swap: Hearty Food Co. Pasta 500g (Tesco value range)
items.reason: Already a good price, but Tesco's entry-level Hearty Food Co. range saves an extra 30p.

items.name: DOLMIO BOLOGNESE SAUCE
items.swap: Tesco Bolognese Pasta Sauce 500g (or chopped tomatoes + herbs)
items.reason: Own-brand pasta sauce or a 45p tin of chopped tomatoes with garlic saves nearly £2 compared to Dolmio.

items.name: COLGATE TOTAL 75ML
items.swap: Colgate Triple Action (on Clubcard) or Tesco Pro Formula
items.reason: Avoid paying £3.50 for toothpaste; buy standard Colgate on promotion at £1-£1.50 or choose own-brand.

items.name: FAIRY LIQUID 433ML
items.swap: Tesco Washing Up Liquid Original 450ml (or Aldi Magnum)
items.reason: Own-brand washing-up liquid cleans effectively at a quarter of the price.

items.name: BANANAS 1KG
items.swap: Loose Bananas at a larger Tesco Extra/Superstore or Aldi
items.reason: Tesco Express charges a convenience markup on produce; standard supermarkets sell bananas for ~90p/kg.

tips: Shop at a full-size supermarket (like Aldi, Lidl, or a big Tesco) instead of Tesco Express—convenience stores add a 10–20% markup on almost everything, plus you'll find more Clubcard deals on items like Ben & Jerry's Cookie Dough.

Ditch big brands on kitchen staples: swapping Heinz Baked Beans, Kellogg's Corn Flakes, Warburtons bread, and Dolmio Bolognese Sauce for own-brand equivalents would save you over £6.50 on this single trip.

Cut back on impulse grab-and-go items: the Tesco Meal Deal (£3.60) and single 500ml Coca-Cola (£2.20) cost £5.80 together; packing sandwiches made from your loaf of bread and buying multipack drinks will save a fortune over a semester.
